title: Invoiced by Flywire Named a Leader in the 2026 Nucleus… | Flywire
summary: Recognized for superior usability and functionality, Invoiced combines multi-agent software architecture with Flywire’s proprietary global payment network…
body_markdown:
September 28, 2026


**BOSTON, MA, USA – September 28, 2026** — Today, Flywire Corporation (Flywire) (Nasdaq: FLYW), a global payments enablement and software company, announced that Invoiced - Flywire’s AI-native invoice-to-cash platform - has been named a Leader in the


*2026 Accounts Receivable Technology Value Matrix* published by Nucleus Research. Evaluating accounts receivable (A/R) technology providers on usability and functionality, the independent analyst firm recognized Invoiced for its ability to unify software, collections, cash application, and embedded global payments into a single platform.


In 2026, the A/R market is undergoing a structural shift as buying authority moves to controllers and treasurers seeking solutions that execute complex tasks - such as cross-border reconciliation, multi-currency processing, and credit decisioning - rather than merely automating dunning rules. Invoiced stands out in the Leader quadrant by embedding Flywire's global payment infrastructure directly into its multi-agent software architecture, providing midsize and enterprise organizations with a unified solution built for complex domestic and international accounts receivable.


**Solving Cross-Border Complexity Through Embedded Payment Infrastructure**


Unlike legacy A/R vendors that license third-party processing partners, Invoiced directly leverages Flywire’s owned and operated global payment network. This means that more than 1,200 local payment methods across 140 currencies and 240 countries and territories are embedded directly within the Invoiced solution.


"


*Invoiced by Flywire stands out because its global payment infrastructure sits inside the receivables platform rather than alongside it, so payment acceptance, currency conversion, and cash application are unified into one step instead of a chain of manual work. That strength in cross-border receivables, paired with a no-code setup that lets finance teams own more of the configuration, earned Invoiced a Leader position in the 2026 Accounts Receivable Technology Value Matrix* .” - Duncan Van Kouteren - Analyst, Nucleus Research


**Key Differentiators Highlighted in the Report**


The Nucleus Research report underscores several core capabilities that position Invoiced as a Leader in the market:


- **Embedded Global Payment Rails:** Eliminates foreign exchange friction, unpredictable bank fees, and manual reconciliation matching by combining payment acceptance and A/R software onto a single, owned infrastructure with compliance and currency conversion built in.


- **CashMatch AI & Smart Chasing:** CashMatch AI matches incoming payments to open invoices even when remittance data is incomplete or covers partial payments across multiple accounts, while Smart Chasing dynamically adapts outreach cadence based on observed buyer behavior.


- **Agentic Architecture & Open Ecosystem:** Features a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes real-time invoice, aging, and payment data to external AI agents, facilitating seamless agent-to-agent commerce, automated remittance mapping, and ledger reconciliation.


- **Fast Time to Value:** Through pre-built ERP integrations - like with NetSuite, Sage and Intacct and Microsoft Dynamics - and a no-code integration studio, finance teams can stand up and configure Invoiced directly without hiring outside systems integrators or launching lengthy IT transformation projects.


"Earning a Leader position in Nucleus Research's Value Matrix validates our core vision: software alone isn't enough to solve modern receivables challenges - you also have to control the payment infrastructure underneath it," said Ryan Frere, EVP and GM of B2B at Flywire. "Where traditional software vendors force finance teams to reconcile disconnected bank feeds across global borders, Invoiced connects intelligence and settlement into one seamless workflow. We are delivering the speed, automation, and global reach that CFOs, controllers, and treasurers demand today.”

How does Invoiced differ from software-only A/R solutions?


Software-only A/R platforms rely on external banks or partner processors, creating data silos, manual reconciliation steps, and unpredictable foreign exchange (FX) fees. Because Flywire owns and operates both the software layer and the payment rails, Invoiced delivers end-to-end visibility, transparent fee structures, and immediate ledger posting—helping finance teams reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and eliminate manual back-office drag.


How does Invoiced by Flywire handle complex cross-border payments?


Invoiced leverages Flywire’s global payment network to support over 1,200 local payment methods across 140 currencies and 240 countries and territories. Through CashMatch AI, the platform automatically reconciles and matches incoming payments to open invoices even when remittance advice is incomplete or covers partial payments across multiple accounts. Additionally, its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables real-time data sharing and agent-to-agent payment authorization across international borders.


Why was Invoiced by Flywire named a Leader in the 2026 report?


Nucleus Research named Invoiced a Leader because it solves one of the biggest challenges in A/R software: bridging the gap between software workflows and global payment execution. While most vendors license third-party processors for payments, Invoiced directly embeds Flywire’s proprietary payment infrastructure into its multi-agent platform. This allows collections, multi-currency processing, and cash application to collapse into a single automated step rather than a chain of manual tasks.


What is the Nucleus Research Accounts Receivable Technology Value Matrix?


The Nucleus Research Accounts Receivable Technology Value Matrix is an annual, independent evaluation of the accounts receivable (A/R) software market. It assesses A/R vendors based on core product usability and functionality, placing them into four quadrants: Leader, Expert, Accelerator, and Core Provider. Vendors placed in the **Leader** quadrant represent solutions that pair rich software capabilities with high operational usability and fast time to value.


**About Flywire**


Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company. We combine our proprietary global payments network, next-gen payments platform and vertical-specific software to deliver the most important and complex payments for our clients and their customers.


Flywire leverages its vertical-specific software and payments technology to deeply embed within the existing A/R workflows for its clients across the education, healthcare and travel vertical markets, as well as in key B2B industries. Flywire also integrates with leading ERP systems, such as NetSuite, so organizations can optimize the payment experience for their customers while eliminating operational challenges.


Flywire supports more than 5,300* clients with diverse payment methods in more than 140 currencies across 240 countries and territories around the world. Flywire is headquartered in Boston, MA, USA with global offices. For more information, visit www.flywire.com. Follow Flywire on X (formerly known as Twitter), LinkedIn and Facebook.
